analogy.rationale: Ras GTPase inhibitors block the upstream node of the RAF-MEK-ERK MAPK cascade, so RAF, MEK, and MAP kinase inhibitors should phenocopy the downstream transcriptional program most closely. Because Ras also feeds PI3K/AKT and other tyrosine kinase signaling, those classes share partial downstream overlap but are less specific.
